    t=o.get('type')
    if t=='response':
        r=o.get('result')
        if isinstance(r,dict) and isinstance(r.get('sessionId'),str) and isinstance(r.get('settings'),dict): mapped['response/session_start']+=1
        else: proto['response']+=1
    elif t=='request':
        m=o.get('method'); p=o.get('params') or {}
        if m=='droid.ask_user' and isinstance(p.get('toolCallId'),str): proto['request/droid.ask_user']+=1
        elif m=='droid.request_permission': proto['request/droid.request_permission']+=1
        else: unk['rpc/'+str(m)]+=1; mapped['unknown']+=1
    elif t=='notification':
        if o.get('method')!='droid.session_notification': unk['rpc/notification']+=1; mapped['unknown']+=1; continue
        n=(o.get('params') or {}).get('notification') or {}; k=n.get('type')
        if k in ('create_message','agent_turn_completed'): mapped[k]+=1
        elif k=='tool_result':
            if isinstance(n.get('toolUseId'),str): mapped['tool_result']+=1
            else: proto['tool_result']+=1
        elif k=='permission_resolved':
            if isinstance(n.get('requestId'),str): proto['permission_resolved']+=1
            else: unk['rpc/permission_resolved']+=1; mapped['unknown']+=1
        elif k in CH: proto[k]+=1
        else: unk['rpc/'+str(k)]+=1; mapped['unknown']+=1
    else: unk['rpc/envelope']+=1; mapped['unknown']+=1
print("protocol_counts (recomputed per name):")
for k,v in sorted(proto.items()): print(f"  {k}: {v}")
print("P =",sum(proto.values()))
print("mapped lines by kind:",dict(mapped)," M(by class) =",sum(mapped.values()))
print("unknown envelope types:",dict(unk))
